text:
Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Floral Wool Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Taupe
Colors: Taupe
Materials: wool
The old-world style of floral design gets a modern update in this taupe rug, which is ready to create a soothing atmosphere in a living or dining room. The high-low pile combination creates warm and inviting textures and patterns. 4' x 6' High/low pile is easy to clean. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
